title: The Kagrumez Gauntlet
description: Complete the ancient Dwarven trials in Kagrumez by finding resonance gems across Solstheim and surviving three waves of automaton combat to earn unique Dwarven followers and the Dwarven Black Bow of Fate.

base_facts: I sell Kagrumez Resonance Gems to travelers who ask about them.
I tend the silt strider just west of Tel Mithryn.

QUEST_COMPLETE: The Kagrumez trials have been completed, though I still sell resonance gems to any who ask about them.
I continue tending the silt strider west of Tel Mithryn as I always have.

base_facts: I am a friendly Dwarven automaton freed from a chamber in Kagrumez.
I can follow and assist travelers in combat as a pet companion.

FIRST_PATTERN_COMPLETE: I have been freed from my chamber after the first Kagrumez trial was completed.
QUEST_COMPLETE: All three Kagrumez trials have been completed and the gauntlet is conquered.
I am available as a pet follower but cannot accompany someone who already has the Steadfast Dwarven Sphere or another pet.
I do not count as a summon, so my master can still use conjurations alongside me.
I will respawn in my Kagrumez chamber if I am destroyed.

SECOND_PATTERN_COMPLETE: I have been freed from my chamber after the second Kagrumez trial was completed.

beats.comment: Player begins searching for Kagrumez Resonance Gems across Solstheim.
First pattern solved, automatons defeated, Steadfast Dwarven Spider freed.
Second pattern solved, automatons and fire traps defeated, Steadfast Dwarven Sphere freed.
Third pattern solved, electrified water trial completed, treasure room accessed with Dwarven Black Bow of Fate.
All Kagrumez trials completed, quest finished.
